compatible_previous_scope: Previously smoke-tested current base; freshly exercised upgrade/rollback here. Not the historical E6 artifact.

daily.scope: Native host to loopback PostgreSQL 14; eleven warmed samples on fresh equivalent 100000-fill fixtures. All monetary arithmetic remains NUMERIC.

snapshot.scope: Paired native host full snapshot+normalization; old redundant validation replayed around the same capture; no DB/network/scheduling

outflow.scope: Native host old/current implementations; 50k shuffled same-time fills, identical final Decimal state; ordinary empty advances; no DB, network or emulation timing

outflow_differential.scope: Deterministic old/current native differential: shuffled timestamps, large expiry jumps, late/future fills, high precision, unknown percentage fees, rebates and reservations; no DB/exchange

effective_read_mix: original eleven routes/rates/latency population unchanged; add 1 event + 1 liquidity read/s with the same separate latency/error gates

full_profile_attempt.error: Timed out: MM start actual command completion
full_profile_attempt.diagnosis: Uncaught closing-transport ConnectionError could kill the simulator public-feed loop; deterministic Red/Green for book and candle sends.

fault_retest.position_fixture: Standalone faults inject and independently verify two real simulator fills, one spot and one perpetual, with duplicate delivery before testing recovery.

runtime_distribution_scope: Bounded retained runtime samples at window end; not complete exclusive per-window distributions.
residual_limits: Native microbenchmarks and amd64-on-arm64 simulator acceptance have different scopes; no Cloud SQL latency claim.
